# TokenOptim Community

Welcome to TokenOptim! This is where we discuss features, bug fixes, and ideas.

## 🎯 Quick Links

- **GitHub Issues:** Bug reports + feature requests
- **GitHub Discussions:** Questions + ideas
- **README:** Full documentation

## 💬 Discussion Categories

### Announcements
- New releases (v3.1, v3.2, etc.)
- Major features shipped
- Roadmap updates

### Help & Questions
- How do I install?
- Why isn't token counting working?
- How do I use compression?
- Privacy questions?

### Ideas & Feedback
- Feature requests
- Platform support ideas
- UI/UX improvements
- Performance suggestions

### Show & Tell
- Your use cases
- Cost savings achieved
- Screenshots
- Success stories

## 🐛 Found a Bug?

Open an issue: https://github.com/adifydigitalnoida-del/tokenoptim/issues

Include:
1. What platform (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)
2. What happened
3. Expected behavior
4. Screenshot if possible

## 💡 Have an Idea?

Start a discussion! We read every one and ship features based on user feedback.

## 🤝 Contributing

Want to help? See CONTRIBUTING.md

Ideas welcome:
- Code contributions
- Bug fixes
- Documentation improvements
- Testing on different browsers/platforms

## 📊 Stats

- **Platforms supported:** 6 (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Kimi, GLM)
- **Code:** ~1000 lines of vanilla JS
- **License:** MIT (free + open)
- **Tracking:** Zero (all data local)
